roles.description: Build, train and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models in Python, prepare data with Pandas and NumPy, use scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and package models for deployment with Docker and Git.
Collect, clean and analyse datasets with SQL, Excel and Python, build reports and dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, find trends and communicate business insights to stakeholders.
Explore data, apply statistics and machine learning to answer business questions, build predictive models in Python with Pandas, NumPy and scikit-learn, and explain results through visualisations.
Design, write and test application code in Python, Java or JavaScript, build web APIs and interfaces, work with databases, use Git for version control and solve programming problems.
